title: HubSpot CRM & Workflow Integration Specialist | Data Hygiene & Business Development Automation

facts: Post: Studio Leonelli is a boutique U.S. law firm seeking an experienced HubSpot specialist to improve CRM data quality, lead management processes, and integration with existing business systems.

Post: Many new business relationships originate through the founding partner's Outlook email; the Mac, Outlook and HubSpot integration causes inconsistent contact creation, tagging, and activity logging.
Post: The firm administrator corrects records but often lacks the original relationship context needed to classify contacts.

Post: Establish consistent contact properties, relationship classifications, lead sources, referral attribution, and tagging standards; resolve duplicate, incomplete, or miscategorized records; clarify responsibilities between founding partner and firm administrator.
Post: Phase 1 substantially completed before the founding partner's international business development trip in early November.
Personalization: business name stated in post. Only one client review (names Michelle), so no first name per U-006.
No native HubSpot or Outlook adapter exists; all screens are the custom workbench, labelled as such.

metrics.name: Complete new contacts
metrics.definition: New contacts created in the period that already have relationship type, lead source and, for referrals, the referrer filled in, divided by all new contacts created in that period.

metrics.name: Administrator corrections
metrics.definition: Edits the firm administrator makes to classification properties after a contact is created, divided by new contacts created in the same period.

metrics.name: Logged introductions
metrics.definition: Email introductions where the email is attached to the contact and a follow-up task or meeting exists, divided by all email introductions the founding partner flags in the period.
